intro.line: Ravnica, the city that is a world. The guilds have kept it standing for ten thousand years.
Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska . . . and Bolas made an even six.
Nicol Bolas is bringing every planeswalker he can reach to Ravnica. None of them know why yet.

finale.line: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.
His triumph came not from victory over his enemies, but from the salvation of those who survived.
Gideon Jura is gone, Bolas is shut away in the Meditation Realm, and Ugin chose to imprison him rather than finish him.
Recorded: the war is over. The city is still standing.

villainFinale.line: When you rule by fear, your greatest weakness is one who's no longer afraid.
Bolas keeps every spark he took, and the city belongs to him. The record says Ugin chose to imprison him instead.

battles.title: The Beacon
battles.blurb: Ral Zarek is in Ravnica when something goes wrong in the city. The Golgari in the tunnels are in no mood for company.

scene.line: Dovin ticked the Planeswalkers off on his fingers: himself, Domri, Kaya, Ral, Vraska . . . and Bolas made an even six.
Rumors float through the city like crows, alighting on citizens seemingly at random.
Surveil: look at the top cards of your library, then keep each on top or put it in the graveyard. Use it to dig and to fuel your graveyard.

villainScene.line: The Erstwhile—rotten of body and outmoded in dress, but unfailing in loyalty.
Nearly invisible strands of web reach far beyond its lair to alert it of the approach of prey.

hero.half: Surveil early. Bin what you do not need.

battles.title: The Queen of the Swarm
battles.blurb: Vraska leads the Golgari. The Boros Legion has marched into the undercity and wants a say.

scene.line: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.
From death she grows living grandeur.
Mentor: when this creature attacks, it puts a +1/+1 counter on a smaller attacker. Attack with the young ones beside it.

villainScene.line: The Boros banner stands tall even if its bearer doesn't.
Squadrons of skyknights are available for deployment around the clock, capable of reaching any district in the city within minutes.

hero.half: Attack with the small creatures beside the mentor.

battles.title: Debts and Ghosts
battles.blurb: Lavinia is a hunter of rogues and the Rakdos cult is putting on a show at the worst possible time.

scene.line: I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right.
Down here, things don't stay dead.
Afterlife: when it dies, you get Spirit tokens. Chump blocks and trades stay worth something.

villainScene.line: They all want to see me fall.
Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

battles.title: The Dreadhorde Arrives
battles.blurb: Ral meets Bolas's army at the walls. The Eternals do not stop.

scene.line: Time to find the melting point of lazotep.
Despite their many forms, the Eternals worked in chilling harmony, unburdened by instinct or emotion.
Amass: a growing Army token and counters on it. Kill the Army, and every counter goes with it.

villainScene.line: Amonkhet's dead flowed into a new world in service to their God-Pharaoh.
I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it.

hero.half: Kill the Army token before it grows.

battles.title: The Kaya Gambit
battles.blurb: Kaya has more than one reason to fight. The Eternals pour over Ravnica in waves.

scene.line: Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.
The Eternals found some sparks to be quite slippery.
Planeswalkers: they win the game when they stay alive. Protect them with blockers, and attack theirs as soon as they land.

villainScene.line: I recognize that headdress. This one was feared even by her fellow initiates.
I've never seen the firemane angels so anxious.

battles.title: Esper Superfriends
battles.blurb: Spring 2019: a pile of planeswalkers against a pile of burn spells.

scene.line: The safest place for you is not now.
By fate or by will, every reign must come to an end.
You are the control deck. Keep your walkers alive and out-grind a pile of burn spells.

villainScene.line: After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time.
I love this thing! It's my best invention since the boulderfist gauntlet!

hero.half: Do not take too much damage early.

battles.title: Golgari Midrange
battles.blurb: Spring 2019: Golgari midrange against a Gruul rush.

scene.line: Now, *that's* a zombie!
In times of war, only death flourishes.
Trade removal for their best creature every time, and win the long game with better cards.

villainScene.line: If the system is broken, break the system.
A Gruul berserker is never unarmed.

hero.half: Spend removal on their best creature.

battles.title: The Dragon-God
battles.blurb: The Gatewatch and the guilds take on Nicol Bolas, who has taken their sparks and wants the city.

scene.line: Break their formation! Thin their ranks! I'm right behind you!
For the Legion! For Ravnica!
You once brought havoc to my home and ruined my mind. I'm here to return the favor, Bolas.
Bolas has more power than any of you. Win together, or not at all.

villainScene.line: The sky boiled over the citadel, dire and dark. Then the angels brought the dawn.
Ugin saw the gem that connected Bolas to his Meditation Realm as the key to his brother's downfall.

hero.half: Race Bolas before he steals another spark.

half.line: He will not be my master.

battles.title: Esper Hero
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a quiet pile of cheap threats and a planeswalker who will not be countered.

archive.what: A white-based aggro-control deck that used Hero of Precinct One, cheap creatures, and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect its board.
archive.why: Cheap threats, Teferi's protection, and a few flexible removal spells made it hard to play around in a field of midrange decks.
archive.beat: Kill the cheap threats early, keep a planeswalker from sticking, and pressure it before its fliers arrive.
archive.after: Core Set 2020 and Throne of Eldraine followed later in 2019 and changed the format again.

deck.name: Esper Hero
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.
Burn their cheap creatures, then smash through before Teferi settles in.

villainScene.line: I keep reminding myself we do this because others can't, because we love this city. If we don't save it, no one will.

after.line: Recorded: Core Set 2020 and Throne of Eldraine followed later in 2019 and changed the format again.
